stem_book: A 5 kg block rests on a rough incline of 37° (μ = 0.6). A force F = 50 N pulls it up the incline through a string passing over a pulley at the top. Find the friction force and its direction on the block by the inclined plane. (g = 10 m/s²) (a) 30 N, up the incline (b) 24 N, down the incline (c) 20 N, up the incline (d) none of these
key: d none of these (20 N, down the incline)
correct_answer: d none of these (friction = 20 N down the incline)
work: F − mg sin37 = 50 − 30 = 20 N < μ mg cos37 = 24 N → static f = 20 N down the incline (not listed)
